description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Rend Rupture
sections.description_summary: 4 s into battle, marks the enemy that has taken the most damage as Prey. Throws a guaranteed-critical spear for true damage, then triggers all Rend stacks on that target for extra damage.

sections.name: Savage Wound
sections.description_summary: critical spear throws deal extra damage based on target initial max HP.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Crit; after inflicting 15 Rend stacks, gains additional Crit.

sections.name: Pack Tactics
sections.description_summary: reduces Prey's Crit Resist. Allied critical hits on Prey apply Rend stacks; LV 3 reduces Vitality and increases damage taken at 15 Rend stacks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: each critical hit increases Crit DMG Boost based on Nazrik's Crit Rate.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: stationary-tile condition; after 3 s increases damage and Haste; higher ranks add shield/steadfast.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate normal-attack stacking and refine stats.

sections.name: Floral Splendor
sections.description_summary: marks an enemy with a flower for the rest of battle; damages marked enemies and adjacent enemies. Repeated hits within 2 s have reduced subsequent damage. Defeated marked enemies can restore Energy.

sections.name: Floral Inspiration
sections.description_summary: increases ATK SPD and normal-attack damage for Parisa and one nearest ally for 10 s.

sections.name: Flower Power
sections.description_summary: after every three normal attacks, sends a bouquet along a path, damaging enemies and restoring Energy per enemy hit, with a per-bouquet cap.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK.

sections.name: Falling Blossom
sections.description_summary: marks the nearest symmetrical enemy at battle start; after enough marks, normal attacks hit additional targets.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: reduces normal attacks required to trigger Flower Power. LV 2 removes Floral Inspiration's initial cooldown and makes it target an extra ally after first cast.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy and refine stats.

sections.name: Phantom Procession
sections.description_summary: summons 10 ghosts to bombard random enemies for 10 s. Ghost damage heals Shemira; after an enemy is struck 15 or more times, ghost damage is reduced. Ghosts from Ghastly Tribute join the bombardment.

sections.name: Sacrificial Orb
sections.description_summary: sacrifices current HP to summon a Wailing Orb along a path, damaging enemies.

sections.name: Ghastly Tribute
sections.description_summary: passive: ally HP/shield loss threshold summons ghosts. Active: sacrifices HP to deal max-HP-based true damage to a single enemy; if a ghost is present, consumes one for an AOE strike.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Energy recovery from attacks; extra recovery after summoning three ghosts.

sections.name: Spectral Barrier
sections.description_summary: taking cumulative damage or reaching max ghost count sacrifices a ghost to gain a shield; expiration converts remaining shield into damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: each hero defeat summons a ghost.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy and refine stats.

sections.name: Eternal Serenity
sections.description_summary: creates an everbloom field with a healing pool that restores nearby allies over time. Field withers when healing pool is depleted but restores its pool over time and revives when full. Active cast moves the field and releases three healing waves.

sections.name: Lifeweaver's Blooms
sections.description_summary: when non-summoned enemies lose enough HP, field absorbs part of their max HP as nutrients. Active cast applies HP loss over time to enemy with highest cumulative damage.

sections.name: Ethereal Blooms
sections.description_summary: moves field near weakest ally and absorbs HP from nearest non-summoned enemy to restore healing pool.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Healing, with extra Healing after field accumulates a specified total healing amount.

sections.name: Ephemeral Berries
sections.description_summary: every two nutrient absorptions create a berry that explodes, damaging enemies and healing allies. Higher ranks permanently improve field recovery after early absorptions.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: enemies entering the everbloom field take damage and are stunned, once per enemy every 12 s.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: healing an ally increases their ATK for 8 s; higher ranks add Healing after a cumulative-healing threshold.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: The Main Course
sections.description_summary: passive: when Voracia damages at least three enemies (or all surviving enemies) with a skill, her appetite awakens and grants Fervor to that skill. Active: creates a plate, pulls enemies within 2 tiles onto it, knocks them down for 4 s, then deals heavy damage and heals based on actual damage. Fervor adds Penetration.

sections.name: Prime Cut
sections.description_summary: slashes the area with the most enemies; Fervor adds an extra slash.

sections.name: Vino Inferno
sections.description_summary: roasts enemies in a selected 1-tile area for 5 s; Fervor ignites the wine at the end for extra damage.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: ATK; extra ATK after appetite awakens.

sections.name: Chef's Choice
sections.description_summary: once all skills have gained Fervor, devours the enemy with highest cumulative damage, absorbs basic stats and permanently removes all Energy if target is not a boss.

capture_status_notes: **Capture excerpt ends during Exclusive Equipment levels; Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.**

sections.name: Life's Embrace
sections.description_summary: releases three battlefield-wide healing waves. If an allied Bulbsprite is healed, it sends a water ring from its host's position, damaging enemies. Solise is unaffected while casting.

sections.name: Lifebloom Buds
sections.description_summary: opening passive sends a Bulb to each non-summoned ally; Bulbs heal their host periodically and store excess healing. At threshold, Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite that permanently increases host ATK.

sections.name: Resonant Bloom
sections.description_summary: when a Bulb blooms, grants host Phys/Magic DEF; further excess healing levels up Bulbsprite and adds host ATK, with a maximum of three upgrades.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: while casting Life's Embrace, Bulbsprite damage gains bonus damage based on stored excess healing.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: healing an ally increases their ATK for 8 s; higher ranks add Healing after a cumulative-healing threshold.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: Season Charm

sections.name: Soul Retaliation
sections.description_summary: charges briefly, then slashes enemies in range for ATK damage plus a percentage of damage received during charge; gains Life Drain and is unaffected while casting. If interrupted, higher level allows his soul to complete the slash.

sections.name: Soul Plunder
sections.description_summary: targets the highest-HP enemy not already affected, drains current HP to increase Thoran's max HP and makes target take increased damage for the rest of battle.

sections.name: Aerial Thunder
sections.description_summary: at battle start throws grenades at three enemies, detonates them, stuns enemies in a 1-tile arc, deals damage and reduces Phys DEF.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: gains a shield when dealing damage to the targeted enemy for the first time. LV 2 increases Crit and empowers critical normal attacks against a bounty target with extra damage and Life Drain.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: critical-hit splash damage to enemies within 1 tile; higher ranks convert some critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Funereal Ring
sections.description_summary: creates a tombstone at battle start; every time an enemy hero loses 40% HP, summons another tombstone near that enemy. Igor stands on a tombstone and remains steadfast. Ultimate damages all enemies.

sections.name: Ghastly Explosion
sections.description_summary: activates tombstones periodically or on Ultimate; Igor jumps to an activated tombstone, damaging adjacent enemies. Becomes damage-immune and untargetable while casting; tombstones activated by Ultimate grant extra damage.
